scientific_limitations: The theorem addresses the maximum label span across both phases of primitive period-two states of K_{a,b} for a,b>=2. It does not classify basins or preperiods, arbitrary transient-state amplitudes, fixed total chip amounts, or the singleton-shore star case. The finite checker corroborates but is not the proof. Previously developed edge-potential ideas are not claimed as new. Some unindexed prior equivalence cannot be ruled out.
title: A sharp two-phase amplitude bound for integer diffusion on complete bipartite graphs
